task_plan.request: Fix all reviewed message/session lifecycle issues without adding pause IDs or additional lifecycle owners.
task_plan.independent_standard_fix: Stale idle countdown rejection and retained interruption eligibility at TTS end are implemented and tested independently. Playback-driven idle startup and completion metrics remain pending this protocol gate.
acceptance_criteria: Audio completion requires producer closure, ended synthesis, and matching playback receipts.
Generation/TTS end cannot mark successful audio completion or end playback interruptibility.
Message lifecycle emits exactly one successful completion metric and idle-start request.
Session lifecycle rejects superseded idle countdowns and new activity stops idle timing.
Same-ID segments are distinguished using playback_sequence; timestamps are not identities.
Failure, missing callback, cancellation, mode switch, and legacy-client behavior are explicit.
Dispatcher remains packet routing/I/O. Pause controls and the Streamer interface remain unchanged.

ownership.coordinator: Lifecycle design, packet contracts, adapter routing integration, and evidence
ownership.producer_worker: Explicit producer closure at model/workflow/remote executor boundaries
ownership.synthesis_worker: Originating sequence propagation through existing text/TTS/watchdog paths
ownership.transport_worker: Sequence echo from native/gRPC/WebRTC output boundaries
ownership.reviewer: Read-only independent review; no implementation authorship

risks: Legacy clients cannot echo playback_sequence and must not be silently treated as successful playback.
Producer closure is distinct from intermediate tool generation and from pipeline drain.
Provider callbacks must preserve their originating sequence, not relabel using current state.
Acknowledgment timeout is bounded and pause-aware; expiry is failure, not successful playback.
A receipt observed during Send cannot authorize success when that Send fails.
verification_commands: just agent-finalize with exact changed file inventory
task_plan.rollback: Restore pre-authority adapter behavior without removing additive fields, sequence-aware clients, or the independent idle-expiry fix.
